## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      3 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 12 mar 2026 - 2 may 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios reportan problemas de fiabilidad. Apunta a gaps de calidad que un competidor puede explotar.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _fuesec_, 2 may 2026, 1/5: "App is slow to respond e.g. deleting an item from a list"
            2. _exposetruth_, 18 abr 2026, 1/5: "This bug is constantly coming back where you add to your To Dos and it doesn’t update and it either skips it or doesn’t show it at all. I sent a message to their admin to report the bug and they were rude saying just use the app itself for now. Completely unacceptable and not professional. this app could easily have 4 to 5 stars but it’s no wonder they have 2.4 only. Please have this fixed. I’m not alone so many people are leaving the app bc of this constant back and forth"
            3. _vanskik3_, 14 mar 2026, 1/5: "A recent update changed the look of the app but resulted in the app constantly crashing. It’s almost unusable. They should roll back the update."

## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Precio y paywall.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 11 jun 2026 - 16 jul 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _written11_, 11 jun 2026, 3/5: "It’s a great app and I definitely recommend it to anyone who is motivated by gamification. It’s a little confusing to navigate at first, but great once you get the hang of it. However if you want to collect all the pets and such, you have no choice but to subscribe. Pet quests can be gained if you join a party with people who have subscriptions, but for pets that can’t be obtained through quests you’re basically screwed. Challenges can give you gem rewards, but chances of winning are very slim. I would love if gems were purchasable with coins but were very expensive per gem to encourage people to either grind for them or subscribe. That being said I can see how that could be abused with FCV and spamming habits, so if that were implemented those things would need to be adjusted and capped. But I do think it’s doable and less scammy, and honestly a more motivating option. I’ve fallen off Habitica a lot because when those things are unattainable there’s little incentive to actually use the app TL;DR: Good app overall but in my opinion the motivating factors are not sustainable. Claims not to be a pay to win game but absolutely is one if you want to collect things, which is the main reward system of the game. Needs adjustments"
            2. _AKpopFan420_, 16 jul 2026, 4/5: "I crashed out from the penalties when having a tough time and ended up uninstalling it for almost 3 years but i’m back because it’s the only task manager that’s actually worked on me. Just wish certain things werent blocked by paywall"
